svg.text: Hairpin Maze Layout and Zone Assignment
Overshoot Zone (overlapping -- Column After Reward + T9 + Terminal + Overshoot Column)
Pre-Reward Zone (overlapping -- Top Corners T6-half + Column Zone col6 + Bottom Corners T7 + Column Before Reward)
Purple outlines = 2x2 turn blocks T1-T9. Black lines = walls.
